analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md is supplied. Units 8 and 9 are base text (old lines 1324-1795). Unit 10 is head text (new lines 1-221). The visible change is new Unreleased and 0.9.18/0.9.19 entries at the top. No executable code, config or threat-model file is in the batch, so the described behavior cannot be checked against source.

Security-relevant claims in the new entries, mapped to existing threats:
- Cache storage controls (head lines 8-10: `cache set --daily-write-gb --directory`, external volume with encryption required and UUID pinned, no fallback, keys and ledger kept on the Mac). Consistent with the T-041 CacheVolume/CacheStorage mitigation. Next pass should check the CLI and provider-swift KVCacheSSD files.
- SSD cache write budget (line 85) and demanded checkpoint reuse (lines 21-30, including SSD write share for repeated checkpoints). Both relate to T-041 and SEC-035. Check that no raw prefix hash reaches disk and that the 30-minute TTL cap is unchanged.
- Autopilot floor (lines 36-46) and machine-scoped Autopilot (lines 52-57). Covered by T-060, T-055, TB-006 and TB-011. Needs a code check that reward authorization uses the declaration's server receive time, that cohort lookup is batched, and that admin pool-cap and baseline-repair endpoints are admin-gated.
- Account erasure and soft-delete (lines 131-149, 173-178; the mutation gate at line 125 defaults to false). Covered by T-059. Check fences against delayed writes, and that the outbox log carries no upstream error text.
- Log PII removal (line 157). Relates to T-051 and T-058.
- Review-clearance change (line 14): member-only Layr-Labs clearance with a separate read-only membership token. This is CI governance and is outside the threat model.

No contradiction with the threat model is visible from the changelog text alone. All claims are unverified because the implementing source is missing, which limits coverage.
